## VERDICT: BLOCK

Exact audited head: `8b9c13c2026c8cd260e3ac5425800c114147353c`; independent auditor, neither builder nor merger; scope is the C05/C07 diff over frozen #606 `fea77085d7e398518f017f1e48e1f27cfdfb4777`, plus relevant tenancy, assignment/idempotency and Roman privacy dependencies. [Audited PR](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)

### Findings

- **A607-1 — Stale sub-coach assignment admits a foreign tenant to health answers.** `src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts:146-159` delegates to `SubCoachScopeService.canAccessClient`, whose `src/sub-coach/sub-coach-scope.service.ts:59-68` filters only by open assignment, student role and deletion, not the client's **current** head/coach relationship; the existing attach-code path (`src/invite-codes/invite-codes.service.ts:606-608`) changes `User.coach_id` without retiring those rows. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
  Independent reproduction using the **real** scope service with a stale head-A assignment and a client now attached to head-B makes `getCoachConsultation('foreign-sub', 'client')` return the client's synthetic screening note when the Prisma server path can read the rows; this is a service authorization reproduction, not a production/live-RLS claim. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
  **Fix:** require assignment head, reader's current team and client's current coach/head to match (and live coach/client status) in one current-tenancy predicate, revoke stale assignments on transfer, and add an actual endpoint + non-bypass DB test requiring 404 for the old team after transfer. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)

- **A607-2 — New safety answers can complete with the old advanced prescription after a retry.** `src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts:426-435` freezes only the logical key while recomputing days/overlay from new answers, `:466-479` reuses the already-cached assignment, and `:303-321` still permits consultation edits after a failed finalization. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
  Independent service/idempotency-double reproduction: advanced gym/four-day assignment succeeds, finalization fails, client saves P1=yes, retry makes no new materialization/assignment and returns the old Strength & Balance clone while reporting `days_per_week: 2`; the original selection had four days and no extra-care overlay, contrary to the rule that any safety yes selects Foundations with extra care. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
  **Fix:** freeze a complete revision/selection/start-date/result snapshot for a completion attempt, disallow or reconcile edits while assignment side effects are outstanding, and never finalize a newly flagged consultation against an old higher-intensity clone; prove failure-after-assignment + safety edit + retry with the real frozen-assignment path. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)

- **B607-1 — Concurrent resume saves lose answers.** `src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts:234-236,269-272,303-308` reads/merges outside the transaction and then replaces the whole JSON snapshot, so concurrent disjoint chapter saves can both return 200 yet the second discards the first; the independent reproduction saves G1 and B1 concurrently and the final head contains B1 but no G1, despite two revisions being appended. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
  **Fix:** lock/read/merge/revise atomically in the same transaction or use current-revision optimistic compare-and-swap with bounded retry, and bind profile synchronization to the committed revision so older saves cannot overwrite newer derived fields. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)

- **B607-2 — The expiring claim has no fencing token; two workers can finalize.** `src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts:439-449,485-497,574-580,602-605` admits a second worker after 120 seconds but never verifies claim ownership/current revision before final writes or release; independent reproduction pauses worker 1 after its assignment is cached, completes worker 2 at +120001ms, then resumes worker 1, producing **two MacroTargets and two coach alerts** with only one assignment call. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
  **Fix:** use a unique claim/attempt token with compare-and-swap finalization and release, serialize the final transaction against that token, and enforce uniqueness for initial-target/notification effects; add stale-worker, lease-expiry and process-crash integration cases. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)

- **B607-3 — New health-table RLS/immutability boundaries lack live acceptance proof.** `prisma/migrations/20270202000000_clinic_onboarding_intake/migration.sql:152,175` permits self/owner/direct current coach only, while the API promises assigned sub-coach and head-of-coach access; the intended privileged versus non-bypass execution boundary is not proved by the all-double onboarding suite or the required live job, which applies the old helper migration and runs only `test/rls/helper-functions.spec.ts` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:281-308`). [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607) [Actual live job](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36801816941/job/110177606097)
  **Fix:** add an authoritative live lane applying the new migration and exercising actual roles/GUCs: self, direct coach, authorized head/sub-coach via the intended route, foreign/former team, anon, INSERT/UPDATE ownership checks, revision UPDATE/DELETE denial, and denied pre-consent storage; demonstrate API/RLS audience parity and the completion path's narrowly-scoped privileged writes rather than treating green helper tests as proof of the new tables. [Audited candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)

The stacked #606 findings remain separately tracked as B606-1/B606-2; this audit does not waive them. [Earlier independent verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/606#issuecomment-5923164413)

### Checks and positive evidence

- Consent-first enforcement rejects valid answers both before and bundled with first consent without intake/revision/profile writes, accepts P0 alone, rejects stale copy versions and P0 withdrawal; own-key validation/Map merge rejects prototype keys, and the changed module emits no answer-bearing analytics or logs while the redactor covers answers/screening/completion-result objects. [Candidate and tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
- The pure seven-priority rule table and materialization logic match the binding program matrix on inspection; the fixture-oracle matrix covers 86,400 combinations (agreement with that oracle is not independent production proof), and the loader rejects production-tagged targets before DB access unless both content approval and the exact version/hash approval flag exist. [Candidate and tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
- Roman session reads scope `user_id` to the caller before querying messages; no changed coach/onboarding view queries Roman messages, and an independent privacy test confirms coach/sub-coach/owner identities receive 404 before any client-transcript read. [Candidate and tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
- **Local targeted evidence:** six onboarding/seed/macros suites eventually completed with **79 tests passed** (five suites/57 tests + service suite/22 tests); two Roman service/controller suites had **29 tests passed**; audit-only adversarial/privacy suite had **5 tests passed**, reproducing four defects and verifying Roman denial, not certifying acceptance. [Audited PR](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
- Local limitations: initial standard ts-jest run encountered a copied Prisma-client/schema mismatch and a 2-GB heap exhaustion; generated the worktree-private Prisma client, used an isolated/transpile-only transform, and preserved the original Babel transform for the service/Roman runs after a TS-only override exposed an ESM parsing error; no dependency installation, full local run, source edits or pushes. [Audited PR](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)
- All **nine required check runs SUCCESS** are bound to `8b9c13c2`: build-and-test, rls-floor-guard, rls-live-tests, mwb-3-live-tests, npm audit, CodeQL JS/TS, Banned cast tokens, build-sbom, danger; actual CI checkout was merge `25f214f` of this head into `bffae5f`, and CI reports 608 passing/18 skipped suites, 10,303 passing/201 skipped/5 todo tests, helper-RLS 31 tests, MWB 52 + 7 tests. [Authoritative CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36801816941/job/110177606019) [Strict required-status policy](https://api.github.com/repos/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/branches/main/protection/required_status_checks)
- **C607-1 / additional CI:** non-required `shellcheck (scripts/*.sh)` is FAILURE for SC2015 at `scripts/s10-core-diff-gate.sh:58,77,132`, a file unchanged by this stack; fix/triage in its owning infra lane, and do not describe the entire rollup as green. [Shellcheck diagnostics](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36801816930/job/110177606093)

**Merge condition:** close A607-1/A607-2 and B607-1/B607-2/B607-3, resolve the inherited #606 blockers, obtain both independent T4 exact-final-head attestations and all required CI green; owner approval still required before production seeding. [PR #607](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)

## VERDICT: BLOCK

**Exact audited head:** `064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f`, stacked on #606 `3c707694f033fef92f5c3391a1fed1b831ce7b1e`. Independent Sol follow-up; scope: all prior findings, current tenancy, consent-first, save CAS, completion fencing/hooks, safety re-selection, live RLS parity, and authoritative CI. [Candidate #607](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)

### A607-3 — A, privacy/tenancy blocker: finalization can send a screening flag and onboarding effects to the former coach

**`src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts:643-655,670-711,739-749,779-786`** fences only the intake token/revision, not the client's current attachment; coach identity was read before assignment, and the last attachment check is before assignment, not inside finalization. [Finalization](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L636-L787) [Pre-assignment check](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L947-L958)

Independent reproduction transfers the client from head A to head B after assignment succeeds but before finalization: completion still succeeds as head A, writes A's MacroTarget, joins A's spaces, sends A an `onboarding_screening_review` alert for a P1=yes answer, and calls the completion/welcome hook with A. Attach-code transfer updates the user and assignments without invalidating the intake claim. [Affected effects](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L670-L786) [Transfer transaction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/invite-codes/invite-codes.service.ts#L593-L605)

**Fix:** lock/revalidate live client and coach tenancy inside the same transaction as all completion effects, with compatible locking or claim invalidation on transfer; reject a changed attachment before any old-coach writes. Add transfer/revocation interleaving tests including macro targets, memberships, screening alerts, and durable welcome-message jobs.

### A607-2-R1 / B607-2-R1 — A, safety blocker: the assignment remains outside the revision/token fence

**`src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts:616-629,803-822,1013-1017`** still assigns before the fenced transaction, and only retires a fenced-off worker's clone if another worker has already completed with a different winning clone. [Unfenced assignment](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L612-L657) [Conditional cleanup](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L803-L822)

Independent reproduction pauses worker 1 before its assignment, expires the claim at +120001 ms, saves P1=yes, then resumes worker 1 **without starting a second completion**: it assigns the old four-day Strength & Balance selection, then returns 409 `completion_in_progress`; no stale-clone retirement is attempted because there is no winner. The real assignment implementation commits assignment/snapshot rows and emits a push before returning to the intake fence. [Assignment call](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L1012-L1024) [Assignment transaction and push](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/workout-builder/workout-builder.service.ts#L1378-L1403)

**Fix:** fence the assignment/snapshots and durable notification enqueue against the same claimed revision/token and current tenancy, preferably in the final transaction; preparation can occur beforehand, but stale preparation must never become client-visible. Do not depend on a future successful completion to remove an unsafe assignment. Add the no-winning-worker regression and cover push/outbox effects.

### Prior finding disposition

- **A607-1 closed for stale/cross-head consultation reads:** current-tenancy API predicate and SQL helper match; transfer, moved/revoked sub-coach, deleted users and forged cross-head assignments are covered. [API predicate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L202-L247) [Live parity suite](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/test/rls/onboarding-intake-rls.spec.ts)
- **A607-2 partial:** failed-finalization then edited-answer retry now re-selects the safe program, but the no-winning-worker race above remains. [Selection and idempotency](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L575-L629)
- **B607-1 closed:** CAS/remerge, bounded `save_conflict`, first-save P2002 retry and same-transaction revision/profile sync replace lost updates; consent-only-first rejection remains ahead of all writes. [Save implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L322-L463)
- **B607-2 partial:** macro target, membership, coach alert, completion revision and injected welcome hooks are fenced; independent expired-lease replay produces one macro/alert/hook, but assignment/push remains unfenced as above. [Fenced effects and hooks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L636-L787)
- **B607-3 closed for this scoped proof:** CI applies the onboarding migration verbatim and runs actual non-bypass-role RLS/API parity tests on both intake tables; owner-RLS versus coach-API difference is explicit. This is a minimal dependency bootstrap, not the full production schema. [Live workflow](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L297-L319) [Live suite](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/test/rls/onboarding-intake-rls.spec.ts)
- **Inherited #606:** original B606-1/B606-2 sequential defects are fixed; new B606-3 concurrent profile/target inconsistency remains a merge blocker in this stack. [Inherited profile path](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/src/profile/profile.service.ts#L76-L110)

### Checks and evidence

Local targeted Jest through `heavy.sh`, `--maxWorkers=1`: **7 candidate suites / 106 tests passed** (onboarding service, audit regressions, answers, program rules, program materialisation, seed, stacked profile recompute); **1 independent suite / 7 tests passed**, including two blocker characterizations and the adapted original reproductions/Roman privacy check. Evidence: `/home/user/workspace/wt/reaudit-606-607-sol/evidence/sol-onboarding.spec.ts`, `pr607-targeted.log`, `pr607-independent-verified.log`; local ts-jest was isolated/transpile-only, private Prisma generation was serialized, no local full suite or live DB run. [Candidate tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/064ffbdea95e5240b50a0d849d2e0e05c5654c7f/test/onboarding.service.spec.ts)

All nine required checks are **SUCCESS**: build-and-test, rls-floor-guard, rls-live-tests, mwb-3-live-tests, npm audit, CodeQL JS/TS, Banned cast tokens, build-sbom, danger; CI synthetic merge `6d26f26` into `bffae5f38cdf2af4eb0d013dc5d2671976f6e657` passed **610 suites / 10,334 tests** (18 suites/201 tests skipped; 5 todo), and live RLS passed **2 suites / 45 tests** including the new intake suite. [Authoritative CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36809689149)

Non-required shellcheck still fails on the unchanged `scripts/s10-core-diff-gate.sh` SC2015 findings; it is not an all-green rollup. [Shellcheck job](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36809689126/job/110201750072)

**Merge condition:** resolve both A findings and inherited B606-3, add adversarial regressions, obtain two independent T4 exact-final-head attestations and green required CI on the reconciled base after #606. Hook infrastructure is not proof that the separate engagement builder has registered a production welcome scheduler. No code pushed; no production seeding run.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#607 @ 245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

**Tier T4; incremental range `7e00de0c97186f9391d98557e534d4a63d74e924..245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53`. The requested code fixes are closed; one assurance gate remains open.** [PR acceptance contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/607)

### Prior findings and D2 disposition

- **Inherited B606-3 CLOSED:** the intake profile sync uses the same row-lock/merge/calculator writer as PUT /profile, inside the save CAS transaction, with the explicit incomplete-input policy; #606 has been independently approved at its exact parent head. [Intake profile sync](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L504-L523) [Parent audit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/606#issuecomment-5936805978)
- **A607-3 CLOSED:** finalization locks the live coach, then live client, `FOR SHARE`, verifies role/deletion/current attachment before any completion effect, and bounds a transfer-triggered rollback/rerun to two attempts. Transfer, detach, deleted coach and repeated attachment change tests check that former-coach targets, clones, assignments, memberships, alerts and hooks are absent; the live PostgreSQL test demonstrates a transfer UPDATE really waits behind the fence. [Transactional tenancy fence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L644-L680) [Adversarial tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53/test/onboarding.service.spec.ts#L1334-L1460) [Exact-head live fence CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36894656743/job/110478499251)
- **A607-2-R1 / B607-2-R1 CLOSED:** the claim CAS, program copy, assignment rows and frozen snapshots, target, community membership, alert, revision and durable hooks are in one transaction; no nested independent assignment/idempotency transaction survives an unsuccessful fence. The notification push is invoked only after commit. Tests cover an expired worker with no winning worker and a new P1=yes save, two workers, stale-after-winner, and rollback on hook failure. [Completion effects](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53/src/onboarding/onboarding.service.ts#L680-L878) [Shared transaction fan-out](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53/src/workout-builder/workout-builder.service.ts#L1325-L1385) [Lease regressions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53/test/onboarding.service.spec.ts#L1175-L1291)
- **D2 VERIFIED:** default P0 copy is `consult-consent-v2`; first storage remains consent-first; only required box 1 is checked at completion; optional AI consent is neither queried nor imported, and box-2 fields cannot be smuggled inside P0. The existing copy-version override is retained as the operator contract requires. [Consent mapping](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53/src/onboarding/consultation-answers.ts#L14-L43) [D2 tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/245da2e76b50fffe68b7e713e3c8c8d399043b53/test/onboarding.service.spec.ts#L1462-L1549)
- **A607-1 / B607-1 / B607-3 closures retained:** current-tenancy audience replaces stale sub-coach scope, transfer retires assignments, save CAS retries/remerges, and the live API/RLS parity matrix executes against the verbatim migration with actual non-bypass roles. Exact-head RLS job passed both suites, 45 assertions; MWB default lane passed seven suites, 57 assertions, including profile concurrency and the new tenancy fence.
